title: Obligation in Legal Texts
goal: Read the future as the voice of a rule and state duties, permissions and bans with deberán, habrán de, podrán and no podrán.

items: I can read the future as the voice of a rule: *Los socios abonarán la cuota*.
I can state a duty with *deberán* and *habrán de*, and a permission or a ban with *podrán* and *no podrán*.
I can talk about an association with *el socio*, *la cuota*, *abonar* and *la junta*.
